spanish: Y harás travesaños maderas de acacia, cinco a tablas de costado del tabernáculo el uno.
grammarChanges: Replaced untranslated transliteration "shitím" with its common-noun Spanish equivalent "acacia" (H7848), keeping the construct "maderas de ..." unchanged.
